events.info: Sin Bandera returns with their highly anticipated Escenas Tour, a powerful live experience that brings their most iconic love songs to the stage. With a career that has touched millions worldwide, the duo delivers an intimate and emotional performance featuring hits like ?Entra en mi vida,? and ?Mientes tan bien.? Escenas Tour is a journey through unforgettable moments, where every song tells a story and every lyric connects deeply with the audience. Sin Bandera regresa con su esperado Escenas Tour, una experiencia en vivo que reúne sus más grandes éxitos y las canciones que han marcado generaciones. Con una trayectoria que ha conquistado a millones, el dúo presenta un show íntimo y lleno de emoción con temas como ?Entra en mi vida,? ?Kilómetros? y ?Mientes tan bien.? Escenas Tour es un recorrido por historias inolvidables, donde cada canción conecta profundamente con el público.

events.name: The BIG Show Improv Comedy Miami
events.info: The Big Show - Improv Comedy in Miami It's our signature show: Live, fast-paced improvised comedy at its best. Think of it as Whose Line is It Anyway meets SNL! The Big Show is interactive improv comedy, featuring our talented and award-winning cast. Come be a part of the fun! Tickets are PER PERSON for this show. We will seat parties together in tables. We will do our best to sit larger groups as close as possible, but may have to split large groups if they arrive late. Tickets are NON REFUNDABLE after purchase. The show STARTS at 9pm and ENDS between 10:45pm and 10:55pm. Coming early? Admission for this show includes access to the shorter One Hot Hour show that starts at 8pm in our adjacent bar/cantina Spotlight stage.
